text: This clip shows the owner checking the hours for a pay period and approving them.
The owner opens the timesheets for the pay period. For each person and each day, they see hours clocked, hours on jobs, and shop time.
On Thursday, Technician 1 forgot to clock out. The owner opens that day, enters the clock out time, and writes a short reason.
The change is saved with the reason, so there is a record. Then the owner approves the pay period, and the hours are ready to export for payroll.
